integrity: Proof is self-contained and finite computations are labeled as checks. No claims of independent verification or historical priority certification are made.
limitations: The statement is restricted to full Margolis-Rhodes monoids of stars with at least three leaves, not all trees; no Krohn-Rhodes complexity or Green class census is claimed. Computational checks for bounded n support but do not prove the theorem. Historical equivalent formulations cannot be excluded.
title: Regularity and rank censuses of \(\operatorname{MR}(K_{1,n})\)
